The generated code contains image and SVG URL constants, e.g. const image = '[temporary Figma asset download URL omitted] These URLs are temporary download sources and expire after 7 days. Download each asset into the project with curl -L, then replace its URL in the generated code with a reference to the downloaded asset. Never use the temporary URLs as runtime image sources.
